candidate_scope: The same frozen heterogeneous candidate masks are supplied to every method; proposal generation is not rerun.

method_scope.raw_proposals: all frozen proposals without ownership resolution
method_scope.greedy_nms: score-ordered NMS followed by maximum-score ownership
method_scope.dbscan_fusion: DBSCAN-style connected components in a fixed mask/semantic/geometry distance, followed by weighted voting and exclusive ownership
method_scope.local_pairwise_crf: local four-neighbour Potts CRF over semantic unary evidence; this is not DenseCRF

identity_scope: Order consistency tests one fixed candidate-list permutation. Only HPID-Split natively exports the persistent hierarchy and package contract; baseline identifiers are evaluation adapters.
